response.title: Reporting on the Bus Route
response.passage:
The newspaper editor gave Nia two bus maps to compare for a report on service changes. She began with the current map, which the transit office had updated that week. Its blue marks showed two new stops near the hospital. A notice beside the route map gave the reason for the added stops. It explained that construction had closed the old road, so buses now used the avenue beside the hospital. Nia wanted readers to know whether this change would last after construction ended.

A librarian found a city plan from last spring for Nia to check. The plan showed the old road reopening in October. Nia then called the transit office to ask whether buses would return to their former route in October. The reply said that no final decision had been made. Nia described the route as it operated that week and advised riders to check again later.
